en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
When you enter Makkah after completing all the rituals required for Hajj and Umrah, do so with tranquility and dignity. You have now concluded everything that was obligatory upon you during Hajj and Umrah.
As an act of atonement for any unintentional errors you may have committed during your state of Ihram, it is recommended that you purchase dates for one dirham and give them in charity. This serves as an expiation for any mistakes or oversights of which you are unaware.
